title: Score Monotonicity Anomaly: Erroneous Score Deductions on Pickups
explanation: At frames 681, 1294, 1316, and 1460, collecting collectibles after reaching 500 points triggered unexpected_score_change anomalies decrementing score by 10 instead of adding points. Violates state monotonicity invariant (PlayerData.gd:L36-L43 set_score), corrupting cumulative player score.
